Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Six legendary adventurers have leapt down from the big screen to delve into the depths of Secret Lair! Now you can bring your own action-packed stories to life as you battle friends and foes with all-new cards featuring Edgin, Holga, Zenk, Simon, Doric, and Forge from Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves. And it won’t take a high perception check to notice the stunning art.

All that’s left to do is loot the room.

Contents:
• 1x Foil Xenk, Paladin Unbroken
• 1x Foil Simon, Wild Magic Sorcerer
• 1x Foil Forge, Neverwinter Charlatan
• 1x Foil Holga, Relentless Rager
• 1x Foil Doric, Nature’s Warden // Doric, Owlbear Avenger
• 1x Foil Edgin, Larcenous Lutenist
